author: Pavlo
body:
Hi guys, its been a while, and this is now my 20th map for the Avicus Network. 

The main design came from a plot I made on a creative server, and I've edited it up to suit avicus. For example there was a lot more vegetation originally, however I decreased this as it would create some lag for users with bad computers. 

Lot's of the map was made by hand,  with very basic world edit (//set and //copy). This took a very long time, so I hope you like it. :)

[DTM] Castle in the Rocks

Creators: Pavlo
Contributors: Xyphos_ (Lunub). Helped with one of the towers, and showed me the server. 
Gamemode: Nebula DTM
Teams: Red vs. Green

Features:
- Iron farms
- 2 sets of enemy armor per team (so you can infiltrate the enemy >:D)
- 2 monuments
- enchanting table? (maybe)
- and more

Your monument is located on the enemy teams side, in the towers with the roof the color of your team. e.g If your on the red team, your monument will be located in the red roofed towers.

Edit: I've added beacons to show where monuments are

replies.author: Pavlo
replies.body:
Changelog - V1.1

I've taken into account player feedback and made the following changes

- Added some smaller pathways
- Added diamond at the top of the mountain
 - Added TNT (for testing)
- Changed all roofs
- Added new castle bit
- Added obsidian for defenders
- Replaced glass water with real water
- Made the middle more aligned and easier to cross
- May have done more, but  I can't remember

Here are new pics of some of the changes
